# monerod_module — Monero Node (local)

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `configure` | `configure(network: tstr, config: {tstr: any}) -> result` | Merge `config` into the stored settings for `network` (mainnet¦stagenet¦testnet). |
| `getConfig` | `getConfig(network: tstr)` |  |
| `defaultConfig` | `defaultConfig(network: tstr)` |  |
| `start` | `start(network: tstr) -> result` | Start the node for `network`. |
| `stop` | `stop() -> result` | Stop the node and wait for it to shut down. |
| `status` | `status()` |  |
| `rpcEndpoint` | `rpcEndpoint(network: tstr) -> tstr` | Loopback RPC URL the node serves for `network`. |
| `logTail` | `logTail(lines: int) -> tstr` | The last `lines` lines of the running (or last run) node's log. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `monerodStateChanged` | `monerodStateChanged(payloadJson: tstr)` | Emitted on every lifecycle transition, with the shape of status(). |
